adjudications.rootCauseAnalysis: PcbCanonicalModelValidator.computeCanonicalHash calculates local JSON digest without incorporating canonicalRevisionId or EngineeringIdentity identityId from Core.
adjudications.remediationContract: PcbToCoreBinding: Bind PcbCanonicalModel to EngineeringIdentity and validate canonicalRevisionId before computing canonicalHash.

adjudications.rootCauseAnalysis: NodalCircuitSolver executes MNA nodal matrix solves on floating CircuitModel objects without domainRevisionBindings or parentRevisionId.
adjudications.remediationContract: ElectricalToCoreBinding: Require NodalCircuitSolver inputs to be wrapped in ElectricalToCoreBinding envelope with active schematic revision id.

adjudications.rootCauseAnalysis: RouteWaypoint 3D coordinates are floating numeric vectors with no topological B-Rep entity IDs linking waypoints to Mechanical Enclosure faces/edges.
adjudications.remediationContract: HarnessToCoreBinding: Bind RouteWaypoint definitions to geometryTopologyDigest containing B-Rep face/edge persistent topological IDs.

adjudications.rootCauseAnalysis: MultidomainPcbIntegrationEngine performs in-memory electrothermal and MNA coupling calculations without triggering downstream stale invalidations when PCB component placements mutate.
adjudications.remediationContract: MultidomainToCoreBinding: Integrate MultidomainPcbIntegrationEngine into InvalidationPipelineEngine so PCB edits mark multidomain couplings STALE.

adjudications.rootCauseAnalysis: FEMCore.solve accepts raw FEMModel objects and calculates displacements/stresses without validating SimulationAuthorityInternal seal or executionAuthority token.
adjudications.remediationContract: FemToCoreBinding: Require FEMCore.solve to verify SimulationAuthorityInternal execution token and sealEnvelope on FEMSolveResult.

adjudications.rootCauseAnalysis: Fvm3DNavierStokesSolver.solve calculates 3D Navier-Stokes flow fields on unsealed FvmMesh3D objects without verifying inputManifestHash or canonical CAD revision.
adjudications.remediationContract: CfdToCoreBinding: Require Fvm3DNavierStokesSolver.solve to check inputManifestHash against canonical CAD B-Rep revision and seal output with SimulationAuthorityInternal.

adjudications.rootCauseAnalysis: CanonicalEngineeringIdentity defines core fields but lacks uniform helper for domain-specific inputs.
adjudications.remediationContract: Extend EngineeringIdentityFactory to provide domain-specific binding helpers for PCB, Electrical, Harness, Multidomain, FEM, and CFD.

adjudications.rootCauseAnalysis: CrossDomainRegistry handles basic domain registration but lacks explicit CanonicalDomainBindingEngine validator.
adjudications.remediationContract: Implement CanonicalDomainBindingEngine to validate binding envelopes and check parent revision lineage before computation.

adjudications.rootCauseAnalysis: InvalidationPipelineEngine handles B-Rep and Mesh invalidation for CAD but does not propagate stale status to PCB, Electrical, Harness, Multidomain, FEM, or CFD.
adjudications.remediationContract: Integrate CrossDomainDependencyGraph rules into InvalidationPipelineEngine to invalidate downstream domain results when upstream CAD/PCB mutates.

adjudications.rootCauseAnalysis: verifyEcadHarnessInterface verifies pin mappings but lacks cross-domain consistency checks for Thermal vs FEM/CFD material models.
adjudications.remediationContract: Build CrossDomainConsistencyEngine to enforce identity, topological, geometric, physical, and functional compatibility across domains.

adjudications.rootCauseAnalysis: SimulationAuthorityInternal provides sealEnvelope and verifyEnvelopeSeal, but solvers do not mandate its usage.
adjudications.remediationContract: Enforce mandatory sealEnvelope and inputManifestHash verification in FEMCore and Fvm3DNavierStokesSolver.

adjudications.rootCauseAnalysis: Electrothermal coupling solves junction temperatures but does not offer formal feedback loop triggers.
adjudications.remediationContract: Upgrade MultidomainPcbIntegrationEngine to track multidomain execution state and trigger selective recompute loops.

adjudications.rootCauseAnalysis: EvidenceBus captures envelopes, but some domain engines do not register evidence records upon execution completion.
adjudications.remediationContract: Unify EvidenceBus and PLMProjectionAdapter to register tamper-evident SHA-256 evidence records for every domain execution.

adjudications.rootCauseAnalysis: UI workbench state displays local cached items without displaying explicit STALE flags when upstream revisions increment.
adjudications.remediationContract: Enforce InvalidationPipelineEngine lifecycle states (CURRENT, STALE, INVALID) across all domain workbench UI panels.
